text:
The customer wants a refund for a duplicate charge of ₹1,299 on their card ending in 4417 from 12 Nov. 

So far, the previous agent confirmed the duplicate charge and submitted a reversal request with the payment partner under reference RV-220918. 

Next, the customer will wait 3 to 5 working days for the bank to credit the amount, though they stated they will file a bank dispute if the refund does not arrive by 20 Nov.
